clinical_history: 69-year-old woman. Exertional chest pain and palpitations. Persistent AF, on bisoprolol.
findings: calcium score only - HR 98 to 115 AF despite metoprolol 20 IV, CTCA abandoned, no contrast given. DLP 41. Agatston total 1186, LMS 22 LAD 610 LCx 148 RCA 406, 91st centile MESA. LA big. no effusion. ascending ao 36 PA 26. lung bases clear.

findings: HR 55 SR, metoprolol 5, GTN, 55 ml. DLP 121. calcium zero. right dom, origins normal. all vessels clean no plaque. no bridge. heart normal, no effusion, LAA fills fine. ao 32 PA 23. lungs clear.
